entry_item.definition: 1 adj. and n. a) Black, dark, obscure. b) Unrefined, common, plain, vulgar; rough, unpolished. c) Profane, secular, nonclerical, lay. d) Evil, sinful, malicious, jealous, jealousy, envy. e) adj. and adv. Large; intense, heavy, violent; very. f) The ninth of the ten cyclical stems ( t'ien-kan) corresponding to Chinese jen. It precedes the names of animals of the animal cycle. g) Idiomatic uses.

To unfrock a priest. See also under a).
